title: Diffusion-Based Refinement for Kilometer-Scale Probabilistic Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.30205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Localized extreme precipitation is a major trigger of urban flash floods and landslides, yet producing nowcasts that combine fine spatial detail with probabilistic uncertainty remains challenging. Here we introduce exPreCast-ENS, a conditional residual diffusion framework that transforms the deterministic 4 km radar nowcaster exPreCast into a 1 km probabilistic ensemble while correcting systematic forecast errors. Conditioning on both the forecast and preceding radar observations lets the ensemble-mean correct the baseline rather than perturb it, while members represent unresolved fine-scale variability. Over the Korean Peninsula, skill improves with ensemble size. In two high-impact events in 2023, a 30-member ensemble recovers 38-47% of heavy-rain pixels missed by exPreCast while retaining approximately 95% of its correct detections and alarming on under 1% of the pixels it correctly left clear. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的公里级概率降水临近预报精细化
translated_abstract: 局地极端降水是城市山洪和滑坡的主要诱因，然而生成兼具精细空间细节与概率不确定性信息的临近预报仍然充满挑战。本文提出了 exPreCast-ENS，这是一种条件残差扩散框架，能够将确定性的 4 公里分辨率雷达临近预报系统 exPreCast 转化为 1 公里分辨率的概率集合预报，同时校正系统性预报误差。通过以预报结果和前序雷达观测作为条件输入，集合均值能够对基线预报进行校正而非简单扰动，而各集合成员则表征未解析的精细尺度变率。在朝鲜半岛的试验中，预报技巧随集合成员数量的增加而提升。在 2023 年两次高影响降水事件中，30 个成员的集合预报恢复了 exPreCast 漏报的强降水像素中的 38-47%，同时保留了其约 95% 的正确探测结果，并且在原本被正确判定为无雨的像素中误报率低于 1%。该方法可在 3（分钟）内生成 1 小时预报。
tldr: 该论文提出 exPreCast-ENS 条件残差扩散框架，将确定性 4 公里雷达临近预报升级为 1 公里概率集合预报并校正系统性误差，在朝鲜半岛两次强降水事件中恢复了 38-47% 的漏报强降水像素，同时保持极低的误报率和快速预报能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces exPreCast-ENS, a conditional residual diffusion framework that transforms a deterministic 4 km radar nowcaster into a 1 km probabilistic ensemble with systematic error correction, recovering 38-47% of missed heavy-rain pixels with under 1% false alarms over the Korean Peninsula.
